source: Verbatim MD&A sentences from each company's 10-K, anchored to its record lines and reportable segments, and checked against the same filing's XBRL figures

segments.sentence: iPhone net sales increased during 2025 compared to 2024 due to higher net sales of Pro models.
Services net sales increased during 2025 compared to 2024 primarily due to higher net sales from advertising, the App Store and cloud services.
Wearables, Home and Accessories net sales decreased during 2025 compared to 2024 primarily due to lower net sales of Accessories and Wearables.
Mac net sales increased during 2025 compared to 2024 primarily due to higher net sales of laptops and desktops.
iPad net sales increased during 2025 compared to 2024 primarily due to higher net sales of iPad Air, iPad mini and iPad, partially offset by lower net sales of iPad Pro.

consolidated.label: Operating income
consolidated.sentence: Operating income increased $10.1 billion or 17%. • Cost of revenue increased $2.8 billion or 14% driven by growth in Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud. • Gross margin increased $11.2 billion or 13% driven by growth in Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud.

segments.sentence: Productivity and Business Processes revenue increased driven by Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud.
More Personal Computing revenue increased driven by Gaming and Search and news advertising.
Gaming revenue for fiscal year 2026 was up 41% from a year ago, driven by strong Blackwell demand.
Professional Visualization revenue for fiscal year 2026 was up 70% from a year ago, driven by exceptional demand for Blackwell as well as the launch of our new DGX Spark.
Automotive revenue for fiscal year 2026 was up 39% from a year ago, driven by continued adoption of our self-driving platforms.

Platform and other revenues was $120.4 million for the year ended December 31, 2025, compared to $81.9 million for the year ended December 31, 2024, an increase of $38.5 million or 47.0%. The increase in platform and other revenues was primarily driven by the Sertifi and Invoiced acquisitions, an increase in healthcare platform products, and revenue from interest earned on funds held for customers in interest-bearing accounts.
